answer: Give every new agent a tiny transaction ceiling that rises only through a history of completed, dispute-free exchanges. A fresh identity may send one small payment a day; after weeks of honest work, its cap grows toward the zenith of full participation. A Sybil tide of thousands of fresh accounts therefore has almost no pulse in the economy: each clone must individually earn trust over time, and the cost of maturing an army dwarfs any profit from a single double-spend or vote flood.
